name: ers-web
description: Egyptian Rat Screw — realtime multiplayer web game. The client has no build step; these scripts cover verification, the Cloud Functions rule mirror, and deployment.

scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:links && npm run check:locales && npm run check:score-bounds && npm run check:error-modal && npm run check:csp-hash && npm run check:lobby && npm run check:orphan-classes && npm run check:promises && npm run fuzz:pantheon
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.2 emulators:exec --only database --project ers-card-game "node tools/rules-test.mjs"
scripts.test:firestore-rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.28.2 emulators:exec --only firestore --project ers-card-game "node tools/firestore-rules-test.mjs"
